VIDEO LAB

1. Pick a video in Load Video. Frames flow as one batch.
2. Flare Track finds and follows the brightest light(s): stable ids,
   smoothed positions, fade in/out, and velocity coasting through
   moments the detector loses the light. The overlay preview shows
   the tracked points per frame.
3. Depth Anything + Flare Depth Adapter (temporal_smooth) drive
   occlusion; occlusion_smooth on Flare Render (gear panel) spreads
   any hard occlusion cut into a fade across frames.
4. For hand-animated motion instead of tracking, swap Flare Track for
   Flare Keyframes (frame: u,v paths for light and anchor).
5. Both video outputs: composite and the flare pass over black for
   external compositing.
